name: AI Certifications
blurb: Vendor and vendor-neutral certifications, cost, renewal, and employer recognition.

items.name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
items.audience: Anyone demonstrating AI literacy on AWS

items.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate
items.note: The AWS machine learning credential still on offer after the Machine Learning Specialty was retired in March 2026
items.audience: ML engineers and MLOps practitioners building on AWS

items.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty
items.note: Retired by AWS. The last day to take the exam was March 31, 2026; AWS states that holders keep an active certification for 3 years from the date it was earned. AWS now points candidates to the Machine Learning Engineer Associate
items.renewal: Retired; existing holders active 3 years from date earned

items.name: Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
items.note: Retired by Microsoft. The certification page states that this certification and its renewal assessment are retired
items.audience: Engineers building on Azure AI services

items.name: Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (exam AI-901)
items.note: Foundational Microsoft credential. The required exam is now AI-901, and Microsoft states the English version was updated on April 15, 2026 and expects knowledge of Python syntax

items.name: Databricks Machine Learning certifications
items.note: Associate and Professional ML credentials tied to MLflow-era practice
items.audience: ML engineers on the lakehouse stack

items.name: Professional Machine Learning Engineer
items.note: Google Cloud's ML credential; widely recognized for MLOps depth

items.name: Google AI Essentials
items.note: A course certificate, not a proctored exam; a non-technical introduction to using generative AI at work
items.audience: Anyone in a non-technical role who wants working fluency with generative AI

items.name: AI Governance Professional (AIGP)
items.note: The vendor-neutral AI governance credential; the governance counterpart to CIPP

items.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
items.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; machine learning and deep learning with Python
items.audience: Career changers and developers moving into machine learning engineering

items.name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate
items.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; building applications with large language models
items.audience: Developers and data scientists building applications on large language models

items.name: ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor
items.note: Credentials against the AI management system standard the compliance section tracks
items.audience: AI management system implementers and auditors

items.name: NVIDIA Certification Program
items.note: Generative AI LLM and infrastructure tracks from the hardware vendor itself

items.name: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: Generative AI LLMs
items.note: The entry credential in the NVIDIA program for generative AI and large language models
items.audience: Developers and practitioners working with large language models

items.cost: Exam and course fees (listed on page)
items.name: PMI Certified Professional in Managing AI (PMI-CPMAI)
items.note: The Project Management Institute credential for running AI projects
items.audience: Project, program and product managers leading AI initiatives

items.name: SAS Certified Professional: AI and Machine Learning
items.note: Awarded after three SAS specialist credentials: machine learning, forecasting and optimization, and natural language processing and computer vision
items.renewal: Expires 5 years from the date earned
items.audience: Analysts and data scientists working in SAS and open source tools

items.name: Certified Artificial Intelligence Consultant (CAIC)
items.note: A vendor-neutral consulting credential from a private certification body
items.audience: Consultants and leaders advising organisations on AI strategy

reading.body:
Six of the nine certifications tracked here are issued by cloud infrastructure vendors, AWS, Microsoft, Google, and Databricks, which means most credentialing in this field is tied to a specific vendor's platform rather than to the field as a whole.

Two credentials break that pattern. The IAPP's AI Governance Professional and the ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer and Lead Auditor credentials are vendor-neutral, aimed at governance, compliance, and audit roles rather than at engineers building on a specific cloud. Their existence alongside seven vendor-specific technical credentials shows the field now has two separate credentialing tracks, one for building AI systems and one for governing them, rather than a single certification path.

NVIDIA's certification program is the odd one out, issued by a hardware vendor rather than a cloud platform, which ties directly back to the compute layer underneath every other credential here. The data does not say which of these nine is most commonly held or most valued by employers, only what each covers and who issues it.
